title: Data Analyst
description:
DATA ANALYST

London (Hybrid, 2 days per week) | £45,000 - £47,000 + Benefits

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded Data Analyst to join a well-known consumer-focused organisation with a large and engaged customer base. You'll work with rich customer and digital datasets, helping stakeholders better understand audience behaviour, engagement, retention, and performance.

The Company

They are a recognised organisation with millions of customer interactions across digital and in-person channels. Data plays a central role in decision-making, with the analytics team partnering closely with marketing, membership, digital, and commercial teams to deliver actionable insights. The environment offers a strong mix of strategic analysis, stakeholder engagement, and hands-on technical work.

The Role

  • Deliver ad hoc analysis and deep-dives using SQL to answer key business questions.
  • Explore customer behaviour, segmentation, retention, loyalty, and engagement trends.
  • Build and enhance reporting solutions in Power BI and Excel.
  • Create dashboards and performance reporting for a range of business stakeholders.
  • Analyse customer journeys across digital and offline touchpoints.
  • Work with web analytics data to support digital performance measurement.
  • Present insights and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Support testing and optimisation initiatives across CRM and customer engagement programmes.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong commercial experience in customer analytics, audience insight, or marketing analytics.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience analysing large customer datasets.
  • Experience building reports and dashboards using Power BI.
  • Exposure to digital analytics tools such as GA4.
  • Ability to translate analysis into clear and actionable business recommendations.
  • Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills.
  • Experience working with retention, loyalty, customer value, or audience insight projects.

What They Offer

  • Salary of £45,000 to £47,000.
  • Hybrid working with two days per week in the London office.
  • Excellent benefits package.
  • The chance to work with diverse customer, membership, digital, and behavioural datasets.
  • Genuine opportunities to influence decision-making across the organisation and develop your analytics expertise.

How to Apply

If you have the right skillset and are interested for this role, please feel free to apply below.
